# BIM Heroes

> > Professional BIM implementation guides and technical resources for architects and engineers using Revit, AutoCAD, IFC, and construction coordination workflows.

BIM Heroes provides practical technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, and workflow optimization strategies for architecture and engineering firms. The site focuses on Revit best practices, CAD-to-BIM conversion, clash detection, construction documentation, and openBIM standards including IFC validation.

## Key Topics

- BIM coordination and clash detection
- Autodesk Revit workflows and troubleshooting
- CAD to BIM conversion strategies
- IFC and openBIM standards
- Construction documentation
- 3D modeling best practices
- Revit worksharing and collaboration
- HVAC and MEP coordination
- Point cloud to BIM conversion
- BIM software tools (Revit, ArchiCAD, SketchUp, Vectorworks, Navisworks)
- Project efficiency and cost reduction
- Design-build workflows
- BIM outsourcing strategies
- Construction drawing standards
- AutoCAD plotting and lineweights

## Revit Workflows and Troubleshooting

- [Revit Worksharing Conflicts Explained: How to Stop the Endless Sync Battles](https://bimheroes.com/revit-worksharing): Guide to resolving Revit worksharing sync conflicts and collaboration issues
- [The Most Expensive Modeling Mistakes in Revit (You Don't Realize You're Making)](https://bimheroes.com/revit): Costly Revit modeling mistakes: origins, phasing, templates, and QA fixes
- [How Design Options Work in Revit: The Logic Behind Multiple Schemes](https://bimheroes.com/design-options-in-revit): Revit Design Options logic for managing multiple design alternatives
- [Why Your IFC Export Fails: Troubleshooting Common Revit-to-IFC Issues](https://bimheroes.com/ifc-drawings): Troubleshooting guide for Revit IFC export issues and openBIM workflows

## Construction Documentation and Deliverables

- [5 Reasons Your Permit Set Gets Rejected (And How to Fix Them)](https://bimheroes.com/permit-set): Common permit rejection causes and BIM workflow fixes for approval
- [From Chaos to Clarity: Creating a Buildable HVAC Duct Layout Drawing](https://bimheroes.com/hvac-duct-layout-drawing): BIM strategies for clash-free, constructible HVAC ductwork layouts
- [How to Fix Lineweights in AutoCAD for Perfect PDF Plots](https://bimheroes.com/lineweights-in-autocad): Complete AutoCAD lineweight guide: CTB/STB plot styles for PDF output
- [SketchUp Documentation for Construction Projects](https://bimheroes.com/sketchup-documentation-for-construction-projects): SketchUp LayOut guide for construction documentation and 2D drawings

## BIM Implementation and Conversion

- [CAD to BIM Conversion Checklist](https://bimheroes.com/cad-to-bim-conversion-checklist): Checklist for switching from CAD to BIM workflow with Revit standards
- [Point Cloud to BIM: The Complete Conversion Workflow for Architects & Engineers](https://bimheroes.com/how-to-convert-point-cloud-data-to-bim-models): Complete workflow for converting laser scan point clouds to Revit BIM models
- [Designing for Modular Construction: BIM Tips That Actually Work](https://bimheroes.com/modular-construction-design): BIM workflow tips for modular construction and factory constraints

## Project Efficiency and Cost Management

- [How to Reduce Construction Costs Without Compromising Quality](https://bimheroes.com/how-to-reduce-construction-costs): Cost reduction strategies using BIM coordination and pre-construction planning
- [5 Ways BIM Outsourcing Reduces Project Costs](https://bimheroes.com/5-ways-bim-outsourcing-reduces-project-costs): Cost reduction strategies through BIM outsourcing with Revit & MicroStation
- [Why Your Architecture Firm Needs a Knowledge System, Not Just Shared Folders](https://bimheroes.com/the-architecture-firm-knowledge-system): Knowledge management system benefits over shared folders for arch firms

## Technical Reference and Standards

- [IFC Validation Tools for BIM Projects](https://bimheroes.com/ifc-validation-tools-for-bim-projects): IFC validation tools comparison for buildingSMART ISO 16739 compliance
- [7 Essential BIM Software Tools for Architects in 2025](https://bimheroes.com/7-essential-bim-software-tools-for-architects-in-2025): Comparison of 7 BIM tools: Revit, ArchiCAD, SketchUp, Vectorworks, BIM 360
- [XML vs JSON in BIM Data Exchange](https://bimheroes.com/xml-vs-json-in-bim-data-exchange): Technical comparison of XML vs JSON formats for BIM data interchange
- [Manual J vs. Manual N: A Professional's Guide to HVAC Load Calculation](https://bimheroes.com/manual-j-calculation): HVAC load calculation guide comparing ACCA Manual J and Manual N standards

## Optional

- [Design-Build for Schools: Accelerated Delivery for Educational Projects](https://bimheroes.com/school-design): Design-build framework for school projects with BIM coordination
- [AI in Interior Design: A Practical Guide to Generative Layouts and Space Planning](https://bimheroes.com/ai-interior-design): AI generative design tools for interior layout optimization and planning
